Go buy some distilled water. Go buy some seltzer. Buy some pharmaceutical grade Calcium Carbonate and Magnesium Hydroxide off Amazon. This selzer is your Bicarbonate concentrate. Mix in small doses into distilled water. One seltzer bottle can prepare a lot of water.

The amounts you should use are up to your own research. I will say this. In terms of measurement it is easier if you mix them together to a planned ratio.
